Name: All items worth less
Author: Daddyfatflab
Description:
Stardew Valley gets a little too easy to make money once you're familiar with the game. This mod modifies the money you get for any item in Stardrew Valley to lengthen playtime, add challenge, and make you more closely consider how you want to spend your season.

[u]FOLLOWING CHANGES:

[/u]- All fish are now worth about half their original price
- All crops in the game closely calculated and re-balanced for a more challenging gameplay (no more super cash crops)
- All gems and ores are rebalanced and reduced in worth
- All food now worth 15 (What the heck does the mayor do with all your old leftovers??)
- Artisan goods and related items rebalanced but still worth a significant amount of money compared to selling their base items
- Some crops that continue to produce after their initial harvest might not pay off the cost of the seed. You'll need to carefully plan your farming to maximize profit
- Other changes to item worth to generally make the game more challenging to get obnoxious amounts of money
- Seemingly worthless items acquired from foraging now worthless! (or close to. Come on what is there to do with a dandelion??) 

SUGGESTIONS WELCOME
